tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Round $n$-sphere and its quotients] ↗ def:ancient-solution

Let $g_0$ be the round metric on $S^n$ with scalar curvature $n/2$. Then $g(t)=(1-t)g_0$ is a $\kappa $-solution for every $\kappa $ no larger than the volume of a unit ball in the unit $n$-sphere. If a finite isometry group $\Gamma $ acts freely, the quotient flow on $S^n/\Gamma $ is a $\kappa $-solution for every $\kappa $ no larger than $|\Gamma |^{-1}$ times that volume. \end{example}
